description: b9d's four burned-count pins made fresh-mode aware in one cycle. In a fresh run the population size is not a pinned number -- it is however many in-window successful signatures b9c derived -- so the coordinate seam, the raw-body seam and verify's reconcile all assert EXHAUSTIVENESS against b9c's inventory instead of against 94,985/38,853. Each mutant reverts one fresh path to its burned constant, or loosens the exhaustiveness, and dies against a fresh fixture whose population (3 signatures over 2 slots) is nothing like the burned counts. Burned mode is unchanged and its tests still pass.

mutants.name: the coordinate seam reverts to the burned count
mutants.old:
if source_mode(b9c_path, b9a_path) == SOURCE_MODE_FRESH:
        population_signatures, population_slots = frozen_population(b9c_path, b9a_path)
mutants.new:
if False:
        population_signatures, population_slots = frozen_population(b9c_path, b9a_path)
mutants.note: A fresh run falls through to the burned 38,853/94,985 count check, which refuses the valid 3-signature fixture; test_a_complete_fresh_coordinate_phase_passes fails.

mutants.name: the raw-body seam reverts to the burned count
mutants.old:
if source_mode(b9c_path, b9a_path) == SOURCE_MODE_FRESH:
        population_signatures, _ = frozen_population(b9c_path, b9a_path)
mutants.note: The fresh raw-body phase falls to the burned 94,985 check and refuses the valid 3-body fixture; test_a_complete_fresh_raw_body_phase_passes fails.

mutants.name: verify reconciles against the burned count, not the derived one
mutants.old:
expected = (len(frozen_population(b9c_path, b9a_path)[0])
                if source_mode(b9c_path, b9a_path) == SOURCE_MODE_FRESH else EXPECTED_SIGNATURES)
mutants.note: In fresh mode the reconcile target becomes 94,985 instead of the derived 3; test_verify_reconciles_against_the_derived_count_not_the_burned_one fails on the coherent fresh artifact.

mutants.name: the exhaustiveness check stops rejecting extras
mutants.note: A coordinate or body outside the population is admitted; test_a_coordinate_outside_the_population_is_refused fails.

mutants.name: the exhaustiveness check stops rejecting a short population
mutants.note: A missing coordinate, body or block is admitted; test_a_missing_coordinate_is_refused / test_a_missing_fetched_block_is_refused / test_a_missing_raw_body_is_refused fail.

expected_survivors_note: None. Each fresh path has a mutant reverting it to its burned constant, and the exhaustiveness helper has a mutant for each direction it must reject. All are killed by FreshPopulationSeamsAreExhaustiveTests, whose fixture population of 3 signatures over 2 slots is nothing like the burned 94,985/38,853, so any path still reading a burned constant refuses a valid fresh artifact.
pytest_args_reason: Scoped to the population-seam classes, which build small synthetic b9c/b9a/b9d fixtures and need no external artifact. Burned-mode behaviour is covered by PopulationTests and CoordinateSeam; the fresh paths by FreshPopulationSeams. Narrowing is about which guards the score covers -- the four pins' fresh handling -- not about hiding a class that would fail; every declared mutant lives in these paths.
